data.name: Archive Extractor
data.description: Extracts all usual types of archives (zip,rar,7zip,...)

data.name: Event Scripter
data.description: Listens to internal JDownloader event, and allows to execute relevant scripts (Javascript). This makes JDownloader even more customizable.

data.name: Folder Watch
data.description: Add Links to JDownloader just by putting Linklist files (*.crawljob) in a special folder on your harddisk.

data.name: Scheduler
data.description: Define time schedules to execute actions, start downloads,...

data.name: JD Shutdown
data.description: Automatically shut down, suspend, hibernate your PC or close JDownloader when downloads are finished.

data.name: Info Bar
data.description: Show a tiny transparent overlay window that can be used to check the Download status or to drop links.

data.name: Translator
data.description: This Extension can be used to edit JDownloader translations. You need a developer account to use this extension. If you do not want to translate, but just change the current language, please do NOT install this extension, but click on 'User Interface'->'Language' above.
